payload.title: Pilobol.us P3-07: move the reader build spec from amplify.yml to the Amplify app with no behavior change
payload.description:
## Goal
Move the reader app's build spec from the repo-root amplify.yml to the Amplify app itself, with NO behavior change, so the same repo can feed the CMS app without the reader spec winning. Proven by an identical rebuild of main.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06)
- Reader app d1od6t7lzbwanr: WEB, repository https://github.com/anthusai/pilobol.us, branch main (autoBuild), no app-level buildSpec (buildSpec empty), no service role, domains pilobol.us and www (verified), customRules only the catch-all /<*> to /404.html 404-200 (real 404s), env var NAME ELEVENLABS_API_KEY at app level (legacy; never print), branch env empty. Build ~1.6 min (job 196).
- Current spec = repo amplify.yml: caches .amplify-cache, clones Papyrus at PAPYRUS_PIN d664fc7 (source import), pip install git+https://github.com/AnthusAI/Markus@v0.5.1, rm -rf web/dist-papyrus, cd web && PAPYRUS_ROOT=... python3 build_via_papyrus.py, artifacts web/dist-papyrus.
- ASSUMPTION: an amplify.yml in the repo overrides the app-level build spec. The CMS app and the reader app will both build this repo; the CMS app needs its generated spec (backend + .next), so the root file must go. The proof branch (CMS ticket) already runs without the file.

## Exact steps
1. Save the current app state (get-app, names only for env) to scratch.
2. Ryan yes (LIVE): aws amplify update-app --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr --build-spec file://scratch/reader-spec.yml where the file is byte-identical to amplify.yml on main (same phases, cache, artifacts). Since the repo file still wins, this changes nothing yet.
3. Pilobol.us PR (feature branch): git rm amplify.yml. After Ryan merges it to main, the reader build now uses the app-level spec. (customHttp.yml stays in the repo: it is read from the repo, not the spec.)
4. Verify: the new main job SUCCEED (log shows the spec ran), then scratch/verify-parity.py --dist <scratch build of the same commit> --live https://pilobol.us --narration = 94/94 and 11/11 (parity harness ticket).
5. Keep a copy of amplify.yml as the PR description / scratch for rollback.

## Acceptance checks
- aws amplify get-app shows buildSpec non-empty; job after merge SUCCEED; live site 94/94 identical to the scratch baseline of that commit; response headers still carry the customHttp.yml cache-control (curl -I https://pilobol.us/index.html).

## Rollback
Revert the PR (restores amplify.yml, which wins) or aws amplify update-app --build-spec with an empty file. No content changes.

## Risks
- If the assumption is wrong (app-level spec overrides the file), step 2 itself changes the build: it is byte-identical so the result is the same.
- A deploy mid-verification can mix old and new files: re-run the harness once before concluding.

## Needs Ryan
yes for the app update (step 2) and the merge to main (step 3).

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
